strings.name: Zhong Shanshan
strings.role: Chairman, executive director and general manager of Nongfu Spring
strings.summary: Zhong Shanshan moved from journalism into business, founding Yangshengtang and Nongfu Spring and investing in biopharmaceutical operations. He has long been involved in Nongfu Spring's branding and management. A former chairman of Wantai Biological, he remained its ultimate controller after leaving that role.
strings.coverageNote: Reviewed through 18 November 2026, with recent activity supported by reporting on the Ningbo meeting and agreement signing on 23 October. The clarification of the 2024 testing dispute concerns the particular sample, not permanent certification of every product.
strings.influence.rationale: Founded Nongfu Spring and invested in biopharmaceuticals, influencing China's packaged drinking water and consumer brand markets.
strings.facts.f1.label: Early career
strings.facts.f1.value: Worked as a journalist at Zhejiang Daily before becoming an entrepreneur.
strings.facts.f2.label: Career appointments
strings.facts.f2.value: Became Nongfu Spring's chairman and executive director in June 2001 and its general manager in May 2005. These roles are distinct from his positions at Wantai Biological.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Building a water and beverage brand
strings.highlights.h1.text: Founded and long managed Nongfu Spring, whose business expanded from packaged drinking water into categories including tea beverages.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Investing in biopharmaceutical businesses
strings.highlights.h2.text: Participated in diagnostic reagent and vaccine businesses through investment and corporate governance. He remained Wantai Biological's ultimate controller after his chairmanship ended in 2021.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Witnessed a production project agreement in Ningbo
strings.timeline.t1.text: Met city leaders in Ningbo and jointly witnessed the investment agreement for the Meishanyuan beverage production base. Signing does not establish that the facility had been completed or had begun production.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Reappointed as Nongfu Spring chairman and general manager
strings.timeline.t2.text: Appointed chairman of the ninth board and general manager, with the new terms effective that day.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Clarification of water sample classification
strings.timeline.t3.text: Hong Kong's Consumer Council reclassified the tested Nongfu Spring sample as natural drinking water, raised its rating from 4.5 to 5 stars and apologised for the misunderstanding caused by the classification.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Wantai Biological chairmanship ended
strings.timeline.t4.text: His term as chairman ended that month. The company's 2025 annual report still identified him as its ultimate controller.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Nongfu Spring listed in Hong Kong
strings.timeline.t5.text: The company's H shares began trading on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange's Main Board under stock code 9633.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Became chairman of Wantai Biological
strings.timeline.t6.text: Began chairing Beijing Wantai Biological Pharmacy Enterprise, a tenure that lasted until January 2021.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Founded Nongfu Spring's predecessor
strings.timeline.t7.text: Established Zhejiang Thousand-Island Lake Yangshengtang Drinking Water Company, which later developed into Nongfu Spring.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Founded Yangshengtang
strings.timeline.t8.text: Founded Yangshengtang and subsequently served as a director, general manager and chairman of the business.
